target_customer: Fiction writers and fans of derivative fiction; readers (consumer)
problem: Writing long fiction and fanfiction is slow; fans want to indulge in fictional worlds.
business_model: Consumer content platform, monetization not stated (tool described as free)
product_category: Generative AI interactive fiction and writing platform (Storio)

founders.name: Rachel Wang
education: Columbia University, Master of Data Science
Peking University, Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering

founders.name: Xinyue Liang
founders.background_notes: Listed in YC launch post, not founder section. YC page says about 15 years of fanfiction experience.

technical_complexity.rationale: Wraps LLM APIs with story tooling and a reader platform; moderate product engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Many AI story tools launched in 2024; a content community could create network effects but none is evidenced.

market_need_then: Large fanfiction readership exists, and generative AI lowered writing cost in 2023 and 2024; no company spend or usage data found.

branding.name_origin: Company renamed from HeartByte to Storio for the product; no source explains either name.

rebrands.why: Not stated; directories say Storio was formerly HeartByte; date unknown

brand_strength.rationale: No brand coverage found. Name Storio is also used by an unrelated UK photo group, causing confusion in search.

outcome_analysis: HeartByte, now marketed as Storio, is a two person company from the Winter 2024 batch with founders experienced at Wish, Instagram and Google, building AI assisted fiction. No verified funding, exit or growth numbers were found, and the status is listed as active, so the outcome remains open.
notes: CB Insights and PremierAlts list about $500K (convertible note, YC and Pioneer Fund) from aggregators only; unverified, not recorded. A Signalbase $5M Storio seed refers to a different business. Storio website returned HTTP 429 so the product page was not read; YC page was used. Competitors found (Storia, OpenStory, DreamGen) lacked dates near the batch.
